methodology.matching: Exact model and storage/RAM/network variant where the source states these fields. Do not mix 4G and 5G, RAM/storage variants, used and new, or different regional versions.
methodology.warranty: Warranty and seller identity are not confirmed for every marketplace listing. Compare price separately from warranty and seller risk.
methodology.market_statistic: Median of the individually listed non-Vodafone offers in this snapshot. This is not an all-market weighted average.
methodology.refresh: Research snapshot only. Prices must be rechecked at retailer checkout; no direct retailer feeds are connected yet.
